video-gob-ai.project_overview: What happens to your website traffic when Google’s new AI takes over search results? In this video, I edited a compelling visual story on the Google AI Overviews shift, showcasing GOBRANDING’s 3-stage roadmap (Technical, E-E-A-T, AI Content) that turns search disruptions into top-ranking opportunities.

video-gob-web.project_overview: As the video editor, I crafted a fast-paced motion graphic video to showcase how GOBRANDING builds high-converting, SEO-standard websites for businesses. By translating complex technical features into clear, engaging visuals, I aimed to help viewers easily understand why a great website is the ultimate profit engine.

video-gob-seo.project_overview: In this project, I edited an insightful promo video that breaks down why businesses are struggling with rising ad costs and declining ROI. Using simple graphvideo-bth—like falling money icons and AI search screens—I showed how GOBRANDING helps companies grow without relying only on paid ads.

video-bth.project_overview: What does a "normal" life mean when society constantly demands conventional success? As part of my graduation project, I shaped the concept, filmed, and edited this portrait documentary featuring Thien. The video follows a 25-year-old art teacher who left school for a self-chosen path, exploring his journey toward genuine fulfillment in an ordinary life.
